videos.title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
videos.description: Christophe Rocancourt is a French impostor and con artist who scammed rich and powerful people by masquerading in turn as a French nobleman, the heir to the Rockefeller family, or as a Russian prince.

videos.title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
videos.description: Matthew Cox is a former mortgage broker from Florida who found himself on the Secret Service's most wanted list; he made millions falsifying homeownership and mortgage documents for five times the properties' actual worth.

videos.title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
videos.description: Jan Lewan is the polka sensation from Pennsylvania who fleeced millions of investors with his classic Ponzi scheme; his name shot to fame when Netflix produced the movie "Polka King" with actor Jack Black playing Jan Lewan.

videos.title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
videos.description: Nicknamed The Chameleon, Frédéric Bourdin is a former French serial imposter who claims to have faked at least five hundred false identities, including a young Texas boy who went missing in the mid-90s.

videos.title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
videos.description: Shaun Greenhalgh is a British artist and art forger; between 1989 and 2006, he produced a number of forgeries including Roman and Chinese art objects, and medieval Christian relics, that fooled some of the world's most respected art institutions.

videos.title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
videos.description: Dubbed the "Mini Madoff," Kiener is one of Germany's greatest con artists, tricking thousands of private investors and banks, including Barclays and J.P. Morgan, to the tune of more than $300 million.

videos.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai
videos.description: Every fall in the northern Pacific, up to a million salmon migrate back to the rivers and streams where they were born to spawn.

videos.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai
videos.description: The crew heads inland to a section of the river to observe the many different families as they fish.

videos.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai
videos.description: During a lull in bear and salmon activity, Casey and the crew decide to head inland in search of the spawning fish.

videos.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai
videos.description: After seeing a wolf in the distance and tracks on the shore, the crew head inland in search of more clues to the wolf's whereabouts.

videos.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai
videos.description: Casey and the crew go out in search of the family of the lost cub from the previous night; they hope that if they find them, the cub will have found them as well.

videos.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai
videos.description: Casey and his crew wander the tidal flats and interior of Katmai and find the bones of a humpback whale that washed ashore.

videos.title: The Tracker's Diary: Tigers of Nepal
videos.description: Casey and his camera crew arrive in Nepal and meet up with local tiger guide, Rajan Chadhary; a seasoned tracker, Rajan guides the team around Bardiya National Park's tiger habitat and establishes a lay of the land.

videos.title: The Tracker's Diary: Tigers of Nepal
videos.description: While walking in the jungle, Casey and the team find a tiger; the tracks lead to a lot of dead ends, but they discover a plethora of other wildlife along the way.

videos.title: The Tracker's Diary: Tigers of Nepal
videos.description: Casey and Rajan discuss different tactics for finding tigers: sit and wait for them to come to the water, or track them on foot through the jungle.

videos.title: Secret Lives of Sharks
videos.description: Go behind the scenes of wildlife filmmaking with Andy Casagrande as he gets up close and personal with some of the most iconic sharks.

videos.description: Rene Araneda leads a tour of the Torres del Paine National Park in Chilean Patagonia.

videos.title: My Wild Backyard
videos.description: Kyle McBurnie and Alex Warham dive into their California backyard deep in the Pacific Ocean.

videos.description: Jacob Steinberg gives a tour of a serene natural haven in his New York City backyard.

videos.title: My Wild Backyard
videos.description: Eréndira Hernández shows off an extraordinary landscape in Mexico populated with animals ranging from huge bison to little prairie dogs.
